claims.quote: Glyptoperichthys joselimaianus originates from the Rio Araguaia, one of the main tributaries of the Rio Tocantins in Brazil.
In Brazil, Pterygoplichthys joselimaianus occurs in the Tocantins River basin, in the states of Goiás, Pará, and Tocantins.
